system.description:
You awaken a sense of mortality in one creature you can see within range after releasing some potent aromas from incents you spread and use as the catalyst for your Genjutsu. A construct or undead is immune to this effect. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw.

Success: Affected creature resists this jutsu’s effect.

Failure: Affected creatures gains a rank of Shaken, for this jutsu’s duration.

Critical Failure: Same as failure, but gains 2 ranks of Shaken.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the number of creatures you can target by +1. If this jutsu is cast at C-Rank or higher, a creature Shaken by this jutsu must spend its movement and Action to move away from the caster, to the best of its ability. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, increase the ranks of Shaken inflicted by +1. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, Shaken creatures take 4d6 Psychic damage at the end of each of their turns. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, increase the ranks of Shaken inflicted by +1.
